required_facts: Original independent numerical/reference identity and RED/GREEN
Exact Fixed40 trace/fixture identity, typed/ranged Worker work counts and bounded progress
All fresh Web rows/attempts and actual Operation/receipt/canonical/pixel evidence
Focused regressions, SDK/binary/source hashes, fresh Demo and cleanup summary
result.json with limitations and READY_FOR_CONTROL_REVIEW or exact blocker
form: Equivalent compact files may group these facts; filenames in verification lock are suggested, not additional proof obligations.
storage: Prefer small JSON summaries and minimal required input/output/Operation/pixel snapshots, compress large raw losslessly. JSON/log evidence <=32MiB, additional raw <=512MiB; at most one candidate build plus reused native intermediates. No copies of entire source/.deps/oldSDK/evidence trees; clean owned scratch after binding necessary evidence.
source_identity: Anchor c5ba plus actual starting revision, changed file SHA256 map and task-only patch. Distinguish ordinary production build flags and any diagnostic test observers.
timing: Report separate inclusive/exclusive or interval-union timings for Worker compute/yield/message/owner prepare/exact/atomic commit/Scene/render wait. Unknown stays null. Never add overlapping workerWait to compute. Primary latency excludes reference readback/snapshot encoding and qualification result holds.
failure: Persist input row/state/job ranges/identities/last successful display/error before owned cleanup. No mutating old summaries or deleting failing attempts.
